search.query: index=winevents user=$usertok$ | stats count sparkline AS Trend by host

table.title: Search for Active Directory actions by $usertok$

search.query: index=winevents EventCode=625 OR EventCode=626 OR EventCode=629 OR EventCode=4722 OR EventCode=4725| eval PerByAcct_7=mvindex(Account_Name,0) | eval PerByAcct_XP=Caller_User_Name| eval PerByAcct=coalesce(PerByAcct_7,PerByAcct_XP)| search PerByAcct=$usertok$| table EventCode, signature, PerByAcct, user, host, _time | rename PerByAcct AS "Preformed By", user AS "Preformed To"

table.title: Search for all Software Installs by $usertok$

search.query: SourceName=MsiInstaller EventCode=11707 User=$usertok$ | rex field=Message "(?s)Product: (?<product_name>.*) --" | stats sparkline as "Trend", count by product_name | sort -count

sourcetype="WinEventLog:System" SourceName=scomc (EventCode=14 OR EventCode=16) | eval Time=strftime(_time, "%m/%d/%Y %I:%M %p") | rex field=_raw "user (?<By_User2>[^.]*)" |eval By_User=mvindex(split(By_User2,"\\"),-1) | rex field=_raw "Device \"(?<Device>[^,]*)" | rex field=_raw "Volume Name: (?<Volume>[^S+]*)" | lookup LumensionCodes.csv EventCode | search By_User=$usertok$| eval Media=coalesce(Device,Volume) | table EventCode, EventCodeDesc, Time, By_User, Media, host, | rename host AS Computer,By_User AS User,EventCode AS Type, Media as "Device Attached/Inserted"
